title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
abstract: arXiv:2611.05873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repeated mobile GUI tests can reuse routes, locators, and recovery strategies from earlier executions. However, a route that worked in one workflow or app version may be irrelevant or misleading in another. We study how an LLM-based tester can retain useful experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations. We present a maintenance contract for AdaptiTest in which reusable experience has an explicit applicability scope, trace provenance, and a lifecycle for confirmation, revalidation, and withdrawal. The contract reserves persistence for a Reflector role and treats recalled experience as advice. The archived implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of every specified mechanism. The design changes retrieved context, not model weights. The evaluation uses read-only Android workflows and archived internal comparisons. translated_title: LLM智能体能学会测试吗？在移动GUI测试中将范围化经验维护为测试证据
translated_abstract: 重复执行的移动GUI测试可以复用先前执行中的路径、定位器和恢复策略。然而，在某个工作流或应用版本中有效的路径，在另一个环境中可能不相关甚至产生误导。我们研究了基于LLM的测试器如何在保留有用经验的同时，排除与当前观察相矛盾的条目。我们为AdaptiTest提出了一种维护契约，其中可复用经验具有明确的适用范围、可追溯的来源，以及确认、重新验证和撤销的生命周期。该契约将持久化存储保留给Reflector角色，并将召回的经验视为建议而非指令。需要说明的是，存档的实现并未建立对所有指定机制的端到端强制执行；该设计改变的是检索到的上下文，而非模型权重。评估采用只读的Android工作流和存档的内部比较。一个包含六个任务、三次重复的就绪子集报告了18/18的完成运行，对比了有记忆与（无记忆的情况）……
tldr: 该论文为基于LLM的移动GUI测试提出了一种经验维护契约，赋予可复用测试经验明确的适用范围、来源追溯及确认—重新验证—撤销的生命周期，使测试器能在复用历史经验的同时排除与当前观察相矛盾的过时条目。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a maintenance contract for LLM-based mobile GUI testing that equips reusable testing experience with explicit applicability scopes, trace provenance, and a confirm-revalidate-withdraw lifecycle, enabling the tester to reuse past experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations.
